answer: In the Data For Good generative AI white paper, BLOOM's estimated training carbon footprint changed from an initial calculation of approximately 39.3 tonnes CO2eq to an extended full-scope estimate of 123.82 tonnes CO2eq. This increase was due to the inclusion of additional factors such as the impact of the model's development phase, which added 73.32 tonnes CO2eq, and the consideration of the manufacturing impacts of the servers and GPUs used.
